evidence.quote: were prepared by arc melting at an Ar atmosphere from higher purity Ti (99.9 5wt.%), Nb (99.95 wt.%) and Hf (99.92 wt.%). To achieve compositional homoge - neity, the Ti-Nb-Hf alloy ingots were repeatedly melted at least six times.
The present Ti-Nb-Hf alloy ingots were homogenized at 850 ◦ C for 6 h
and then hot-rolled into sheets with a thickness of 3 mm.
the hot-rolled Ti-Nb-Hf sheets were heat treated at 850 ◦ C for 1 h
followed by cold rolling with a reduction of 70%
the specimens with the moderate standards were encapsulated in sealed quartz tubes under the protection of Ar and solution treated at 900 ◦ C for 3 h.
